newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet with Hong Kong's Lee.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet with Hong Kong's Lee.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will meet later this week with Martin Lee, a leader of Hong Kong's democracy movement, White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said on Monday.
McCurry said Lee will meet with Vice President Al Gore for talks "at the end of the week" and Clinton will attend a portion of the White House meeting.

Lee is on a lobbying mission in the United States ahead of the switch of Hong Kong from British rule to Chinese control on July 1, amid concern over indications that China wants to tighten controls on political and civil liberties.
"The president will be interested in his thoughts on the transition that will occur in Hong Kong," McCurry said.
The United States has been sensitive about relations with China.
When Gore went to China last month, he did not visit Hong Kong, based on the advice of the State Department and National Security Council staff.
